people.name: Cayla Cothron
people.bio: Joined North Carolina Sea Grant's extension team in 2021 as a climate resilience extension associate, to engage coastal towns and resource managers, assist graduate fellows studying coastal resilience, and continue the state's Sentinel Site program partnerships. Previously worked in community planning; holds degrees in environmental studies (Florida State) and urban and regional planning (University of Colorado Denver).
people.research_interests: Coastal and watershed resilience; climate risk communication; community planning

people.name: Rebecca Ellin
people.bio: Program Manager of North Carolina's Coastal Reserve and National Estuarine Research Reserve, a program of the state Department of Environmental Quality; listed at the reserve's headquarters office.

people.name: A. C. Magruder
people.bio: Alexander C. Magruder was Oklahoma A&M's first agriculture professor (the college is now Oklahoma State University). Planted the Magruder Plots in fall 1892 to learn whether the soil could keep giving good wheat yields with no fertilizer applied.
